title: Vintage Ronson “Leona” Table Lighter – Hand Painted Floral – Newark NJ USA
descriptionText:
This is a vintage Ronson “Leona” table lighter, made in Newark, New Jersey, USA. It features a ceramic body with hand-painted floral decoration and an ornate metal pedestal base. These were popular mid-century home and office decor pieces and are now sought after by collectors of vintage tobacciana and Ronson designs.
Brand: Ronson
Model: Leona
Origin: Newark, NJ, USA
Material: Ceramic body, metal base and lighter mechanism
Design: Hand-painted orange floral pattern
Patent Number: Marked on bottom (U.S. Patent No. 19023 + Canada patents)
Era: Mid-20th Century (likely 1940s–1950s)
Condition:
The lighter shows some paint wear and minor chipping/finish loss, consistent with its age. The metal components show some discoloration/patina. The wick and mechanism are intact. May need new flint and lighter fluid to function properly. Please review photos carefully as they are part of the description.
Measurements (approx.):
Height: ~3.5–4 inches
Width: ~2.5 inches
Includes:
Vintage Ronson Leona table lighter only.
This is a great piece for:
✔ Ronson collectors
✔ Mid-century decor lovers
✔ Vintage tobacciana displays
✔ Home office desk accessory collections
